nodes.name: MountIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Inline SVG mount icon component that renders a detailed gradient-shaded mount silhouette built from dozens of path layers, scaled by a `size` prop and using a per-instance unique gradient ID so multiple icons render independently.

nodes.name: PropellingFunTracker.svelte
nodes.summary: Component for configuring the 'Propelling Fun' jump element (Air/Fire) and buff mode (Air only, Both, Fire only) through color-coded button groups and segmented range sliders, persisting choices into the shared `build` store via build.update.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte with legacy $: reactive declarations deriving slider state from the build store

nodes.name: ScalingBreakdownRow.svelte
nodes.summary: Displays a single scaling-breakdown table row showing a stat's scaling value, boost percentage, and net contribution, formatting numeric values with roundMultiplier and treating boost keys found in PERCENT_STATS as percentage values.

nodes.name: StatFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Collapsible stat filter panel with Positive/Negative tabs, include/exclude chip cycling via shared createFilterActions helpers, and sort-mode buttons (highest/lowest/alphabetical), dispatching filter maps and sort mode changes to the parent component.

nodes.name: SuggestDrop.svelte
nodes.summary: Dropdown that renders type-ahead suggestions for weapon names and perks, highlighting the query substring via highlightTextParts and dispatching a `select` event on mousedown so the input does not lose focus.

nodes.name: TagFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Collapsible tag filter panel grouping perk tags into Combat, Support, Status, Weapon Art/Rune, and Special categories with color-coded chips, an active-tag summary bar with per-tag removal, a clear-all action, and toggle/change events dispatched to the parent.

nodes.name: WeaponStatFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Collapsible weapon-stat filter for Damage Type, Scaling, and Boost/Stats groups using include/exclude chips with DMG/SCL/STAT prefixes, and an exported matchesFilter predicate that tests weapon records against the active include/exclude map.

nodes.name: matchesFilter
nodes.summary: Exported predicate that returns true when an item's stats satisfy every active include/exclude filter entry, comparing stat values (> 0 for include, <= 0 for exclude) resolved from the item's stats map or top-level fields.

nodes.name: WeaponStatsDisplay.svelte
nodes.summary: Renders a weapon's stat block as grouped pills for damage types, scalings, and stat boosts, splitting the flat stats map by key suffix and formatting percentage-style stats (boost/defense/warding) with a % sign.

nodes.name: splitWeaponStats
nodes.summary: Partitions a flat weapon stats record into three arrays by key suffix: keys ending in 'Type' become damage types, keys ending in 'Scaling' become scalings, and everything else becomes boosts.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration that sets the app base path from VITE_BASE_PATH, wires the Svelte plugin, a PWA plugin (autoUpdate service worker with a StaleWhileRevalidate navigation cache), and a rollup bundle-size visualizer while disabling manual chunks.
